description: WinuxCmd release pin for niubash releases (niubash#312). Tag-push releases bundle exactly this WinuxCmd tag: the workflow downloads the matching WinuxCmd-*-win-<arch>.zip asset and fails unless its SHA-256 equals the value recorded here. workflow_dispatch releases must instead pass the same information explicitly via the winuxcmd_tag and winuxcmd_sha256 inputs; this file is then only the reference for what the last pinned release used.
notes: Recorded from WinuxCmd v1.1.15 (2026-10-19); both values were taken from the wpm-source index entry (written by the release build's update-wpm-source-index job) and the x64 value was independently verified by hashing the downloaded release zip (release-verification run, 2026-10-19).
The hashes cover the WinuxCmd-<version>-win-<arch>.zip release assets (the only format the release bundles), not the .7z/.tar.gz/setup.exe variants.
Bumping the pin is a deliberate release decision: update winuxcmd_tag and both sha256 values together, and rerun a release so the bundled engine changes intentionally.

History: v1.1.13 was the first release where a forced upgrade completes while a running git holds the payload; v1.1.14 shipped the layout:shim forwarder's code without the binary (the release zip carried no winuxcmd-shim.exe); v1.1.15 is the first release whose zip verifiably carries winuxcmd-shim.exe (WinuxCmd#1207/#1225) and whose release pipeline refuses to index an archive that lacks it.
Pin jumps 1.1.13 -> 1.1.15 (skipping v1.1.14) deliberately: 1.1.14's archive is missing the shim binary, so there is no reason to bundle it.
